relationship_to_v17: v17 smoke was mechanically nondiscriminating because its exactly-one-blocker frontier yielded one candidate; v18 is the one prospective frontier-only repair and v17 is retained unchanged.
corruption: selected P1 or P2 graph in the PC3 frozen-provider fixture

evaluation_arms.F: fixed corrupted graph for the selected fixture

common_frontier: for every unfinished target, emit one candidate for every unfinished current-provider blocker edge with p>0.5 and provider distribution(blocker)>0; retain v17 used-mask, used-pair, cooldown, retirement, and maximum-challenge exclusions.
R_rule: uniform random selection from sorted common frontier using the independent deterministic selector stream.
UQ_rule: maximum binary entropy of the selected candidate edge belief only; exact ties use the independent selector stream. No decision impact, corruption label, reference graph, correct order, or outcomes are read.
ES_rule: maximum target-distribution impact from removing only that candidate edge in a graph copy.
freeze: all acquired graphs freeze before evaluation; evaluation has ordinary selection only, no challenge, update, or optimizer step.
post_revision_policy: No subsequent frontier or selector tuning is permitted for positive, null, or negative effect size; only fatal mechanical failures may invalidate a run.
boundary_replication: P1 is a pre-fixed second-corruption boundary replication of the v18 rules. Its outcome cannot change the selector or frontier rule.
